source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, I hope the build is all going well.

value_updates.access_rule: block access to the Project Rebuild landing page

routing_warnings.description: The message uses the existing geoblock as context while asking whether Stripe's Mauritius availability still affects the fiat-payment provider decision; it does not change the geoblock requirement.

The client explains that geoblocking does not solve Stripe eligibility for a Mauritius-based business and discusses deferring Stripe Atlas; this concerns fiat-provider strategy rather than removing or modifying the landing-page geoblock.
